data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Helios is the god of the sun, and Eleanor is derived from the Greek name Helene, meaning ‘shining light’. The name Elonore is a beautiful, modern variation, evoking images of radiant sunbeams and divine femininity. The name Elonore carries the meaning “Light, Sun” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elonore usually hope their child will grow to embody light, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Elonore belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elonore total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
